cohort: 526 mothers diagnosed with GDM or PGDM and their newborn infants, compared to 526 randomly assigned control infants born on the same date to mothers without diabetes
finding: Both GDM and PGDM were associated with increased risks of various maternal and neonatal complications, with PGDM generally having higher risks.
mod_finding: Mothers with pre-gestational diabetes mellitus had significantly higher rates of preterm or cesarean delivery compared to controls.
